g.text: It regulated behaviour at human search speed.

text.style: font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #b9b5ad

g.text: The gaps were always there. What kept them shut

text.style: font-size: 12.4px; font-family: 'Georgia', 'Palatino Linotype', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #b9b5ad

g.text: was that finding one took a lawyer a week.
